tools.name: balance
tools.title: Balance
tools.description: Your balance in US dollars: what you can spend now and what is held for requests and jobs still running.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.title: Edit an image
tools.description: Change a picture you give (image_url or input_images, as https:// links or data: URIs) following a prompt, with an editing model. Spends from your balance.

size.description: Width x height, e.g. 1024x1024, when the model lists sizes.

aspect_ratio.description: Shape, e.g. 16:9, when the model lists aspect ratios.

max_cost.description: Optional: leave it out unless the user set a budget. To cap the cost, send quote's max_cost_usd (what is held while it runs), never its cost_usd: a max_cost below what can be held is refused before anything is spent.

return_image.description: Also return the pictures themselves in the answer, so you can look at them.

kit.description: The id (kit_...) or name of one of your brand kits (list_kits): its pictures, style notes and voice go into this request, so the same character, product or look comes back from any model.

options.description: Any other option from get_model's parameters schema.

image_url.description: The picture to change: an https:// link or a data: URI.

input_images.description: Several pictures to work from (https:// links or data: URIs).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.title: Make an image
tools.description: Make pictures from a prompt. Spends from your balance; the answer carries the links and what it cost (usage.cost_usd). The links open in any browser for 6 hours: show them to the user.

size.description: Width x height, e.g. 1024x1024, when the model lists sizes.

aspect_ratio.description: Shape, e.g. 16:9, when the model lists aspect ratios.

max_cost.description: Optional: leave it out unless the user set a budget. To cap the cost, send quote's max_cost_usd (what is held while it runs), never its cost_usd: a max_cost below what can be held is refused before anything is spent.

return_image.description: Also return the pictures themselves in the answer, so you can look at them.

kit.description: The id (kit_...) or name of one of your brand kits (list_kits): its pictures, style notes and voice go into this request, so the same character, product or look comes back from any model.

options.description: Any other option from get_model's parameters schema.

tools.name: get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: The status of a video or music job, its progress and, once it succeeded, the links to its files and what it cost.

job_id.description: The job id start_video or start_music returned.

tools.name: get_model
tools.title: Get a model
tools.description: One model: its price, what it makes and, for an image, video, music or speech model, a JSON Schema of the options a request takes (parameters).

tools.name: list_kits
tools.title: List my brand kits
tools.description: Your brand kits: named sets of reference pictures (faces, products), style notes and a voice. Pass a kit's id or name as kit to generate_image, edit_image, start_video or start_music to keep the same character, product or look across models. Make and edit kits at https://martllm.com/dashboard/kits.

tools.name: list_library
tools.title: List my library
tools.description: Files kept in your library (pictures, videos and audio you made, when the account keeps a library), newest first. Filter by kind (image, video, audio), model, project id or none, and pass next_cursor to page. Each file has a download link that works for an hour; a picture's id (file_...) can be the source image of a new request.

kind.description: Only files of this kind: image, video or audio.

model.description: Only files made with this model id.

project.description: Only files in this project id, or none for files in no project.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page.

limit.description: How many files, 1 to 200 (60 when left out).

tools.name: list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: Models you can call right now, with their price. Filter by type (chat, image, video, music, speech, transcription) and by words in the id or name.

type.description: Only models of this type: chat, image, video, music, speech or transcription.

search.description: Only models whose id or name contains these words, e.g. seedance or kling.

tools.name: quote
tools.title: Quote a request
tools.description: Check an image, video, music or text-to-speech request against the model and price it, without making anything or spending. Returns the listed price (cost_usd; the bill is what the provider charges, which can be less or more) and what is held while it runs (max_cost_usd: it is never billed more). To cap a request, pass max_cost_usd as its max_cost (cost_usd is too low and is refused).

options.description: The rest of the request, as get_model's parameters schema describes it, e.g. {"duration_seconds": 5, "image_url": "https://..."}.

tools.name: start_music
tools.title: Start a music track
tools.description: Start making music or a sound effect with a music model. Returns a job; call wait_job with its id until it is done. Spends from your balance when the track is made; a failed job costs nothing.

duration_seconds.description: Length in seconds, when get_model lists lengths.

max_cost.description: Optional: leave it out unless the user set a budget. To cap the cost, send quote's max_cost_usd (what is held while it runs), never its cost_usd: a max_cost below what can be held is refused before anything is spent.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key when you retry, so a retry never starts or pays for a second track.

kit.description: The id (kit_...) or name of one of your brand kits (list_kits): its style notes (and voice, where the model has it) go into this request.

options.description: Any other option from get_model's parameters schema.

tools.name: start_video
tools.title: Start a video
tools.description: Start making a video. Returns a job; call wait_job with its id until it is done. Spends from your balance when the video is made; a failed job costs nothing.

image_url.description: The first frame (https:// link or data: URI); needed by image-to-video models.

end_image_url.description: The last frame, for models that make a transition.

duration_seconds.description: Length in seconds; one of the lengths get_model lists.

resolution.description: e.g. 720p, when the model lists resolutions.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. 16:9, when the model lists aspect ratios.

max_cost.description: Optional: leave it out unless the user set a budget. To cap the cost, send quote's max_cost_usd (what is held while it runs), never its cost_usd: a max_cost below what can be held is refused before anything is spent.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key when you retry, so a retry never starts or pays for a second video.

kit.description: The id (kit_...) or name of one of your brand kits (list_kits): its pictures, style notes and voice go into this request, so the same character, product or look comes back from any model.

options.description: Any other option from get_model's parameters schema.

tools.name: wait_job
tools.title: Wait for a job
tools.description: Wait until a video or music job ends, for at most timeout_seconds (50 at most). Returns the job; if done is false, call wait_job again.

job_id.description: The job id start_video or start_music returned.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait, 1 to 50 seconds. Default 50.
